name: showdown-ride-search
description: Two parallel workers each run one pre-registered seed range of the Outrider ride-or-fight search (experiments/showdown-outrider/decision/README.md) and write only their own results file; a join step reports both counts.

branches.prompt: You own exactly one output file: experiments/showdown-outrider/decision/results/search-1000-1099.json. Do not edit, create or commit any other file, and do not run any other range. Record the time (date -u +%FT%TZ) before and after. Run: node experiments/showdown-outrider/decision/search.mjs a . Do not commit. Report in 4 short bullets: the start and end times, the exit code, the printed counts JSON verbatim, and the output path.

You own exactly one output file: experiments/showdown-outrider/decision/results/search-1100-1199.json. Do not edit, create or commit any other file, and do not run any other range. Record the time (date -u +%FT%TZ) before and after. Run: node experiments/showdown-outrider/decision/search.mjs b . Do not commit. Report in 4 short bullets: the start and end times, the exit code, the printed counts JSON verbatim, and the output path.

steps.prompt: Do not edit or run anything. Quote both completed reports and state whether each owned only its file. Range A: {{range-a.output}}. Range B: {{range-b.output}}. 3 short bullets.
